## Description

A patient writes to the clinic's WhatsApp number. The assistant says it is automated, matches an existing patient by verified phone number plus a one-time code before any change, and books, moves or cancels through Scheduling (one source of truth). Only appointment facts and secure links are sent. "Agent" or any red flag hands the thread to staff in the clinic inbox.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** No booking change without the identity check; a new patient is booked as a request for staff to confirm.
- [ ] **AC2.** No result, note, diagnosis or medicine is ever sent over WhatsApp (test on the outbound path).
- [ ] **AC3.** A takeover from the inbox stops the assistant immediately.
- [ ] **AC4.** Journey step added for the booking flow with the adapter on recorded payloads.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
